notes: Walton fight of 7 Sept 1876 is one bout (stopped, then resumed; Goss won on a foul). Record entries are from the Cincinnati Enquirer history of the two men as printed, so many dates and stakes are approximate or garbled. Headline says the arrest was at Covington; the text says the trains were stopped at Newport. Allen fought Goss in England (c.1867) and again in 1876.
